_evidence: 0x00445423 / 0x004452a0 (opcode-stream receive): 'cmp byte [0x7aafd8],0xff; je' is the link-down exit (values 0xff and others). Else 0x51f0b8 calls service 0x4c (0x531f9c -> table 0x531d74[0x4c] = 0x532d85), whose first instruction 'cmp byte [0x7aafd3],0xff; jb 0x532e50' returns CF=1 for every value below 0xff, which 0x51f0b8 turns into CF=0, so 'jae 0x44546c' takes the link-down path (sets [0x7aafd8]=0xff). Only [0x7aafd3]==0xff (link session up) enters the receive loop, which calls 0x509b50 (Win32 PeekMessage through the import [0x5f0300] while [0xb1c8c8]==0, its image value) and the DirectPlay receive 0x507360 (COM call through [[0xb1bb4c]]+0x64): an external dependency, so those cases are reported external and the success path (0x445434.., and the 0x4452a0 packet walk that follows it) can only be confirmed in-game. Values 0,1,0xfe take the emulated link-down path; 0xff (a quarter) the external one. The link-down path read-modify-writes bytes 0x8914e0 (|0x20) and 0x7c2ead (|0x10): both varied as plain u8 here, so callers such as 0x4452a0 that do not address them directly still vary them.
